test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct idiom for the word highlighted in bold.

Rohit is very calculative and always has **an axe to grind**.

options.text: To have a hidden personal motive

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To have a hidden personal motive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The idiom **"To have an axe to grind"** means to have a personal or hidden agenda or motive for doing something. (गुप्त व्यक्तिगत उद्देश्य रखना)

 

 
• **Example:** She volunteered to help with the project, but it soon became clear that she had an axe to grind.

 

 
• In the given sentence, Rohit is described as calculative and having a hidden agenda, which fits the meaning of the idiom perfectly.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: To sharpen one's skills** (अपनी कौशल को सुधारना): This phrase refers to improving or honing one's abilities or talents.

 

 
• **Example:** She spent hours every day practicing the piano to sharpen her skills.

 

 

 
• **Option 3: To work hard for success** (सफलता के लिए कड़ी मेहनत करना): This phrase means putting in a lot of effort to achieve one's goals.

 

 
• **Example:** He worked hard for months to prepare for the competitive exams.

 

 

 
• **Option 4: To take revenge** (बदला लेना): This phrase means to retaliate or harm someone in return for a perceived wrong.

 

 
• **Example:** He planned to take revenge on his rival for the unfair treatment he received.

 

 

40:Tcf2,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
